description: This test ensures that users can navigate to the Documentation page from the login page and view the platform's documentation content.
steps: Navigate to the login page at https://dev.roost.ai/login.
Verify that the 'Documentation' link is visible and enabled in the footer.
Wait for the Documentation page to load.
Verify that the content of the Documentation page is displayed correctly.
expected_results: The Documentation page is displayed when the link is clicked.
The content on the Documentation page is loaded without errors.
edge_cases: The 'Documentation' link is not visible or enabled.
The Documentation page fails to load due to a network error.
The Documentation page content is incomplete or displays errors.
The user clicks the link but closes the browser before the page loads.
The Documentation page URL is incorrect or broken.
data_requirements: Access to the Documentation page URL.
Correct configuration of the Documentation page link on the login page.
Network connectivity to load the Documentation page.
dependencies: The Documentation page must be operational.
The footer navigation links must be correctly configured.
api_interactions: No direct API interactions for this test.
performance_metrics: Time taken to load the Documentation page.
accessibility_requirements: The 'Documentation' link should be accessible via a screen reader.
Keyboard navigation should allow users to focus on the 'Documentation' link.
The Documentation page content should be structured for screen readers.
